project_type: Next.js 14 full-stack web app (App Router, TypeScript, Vitest)
build_system: npm (in web/), Next.js App Router with edge/node runtime
test_framework: Vitest with test files in web/tests/
verification_instructions: 1. cd web && npx tsc --noEmit  2. npm run lint  3. npm run test -- --run  4. npm run build (no env vars needed)
setup_instructions: Node is at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin/node. npm in web/. No extra setup needed.
environment_constraints: No env vars available at build time. All DB/auth access must be lazy (runtime only). No docker daemon. Branch is main, push directly to origin/main.
contribution_requirements: All user-facing text in Spanish. Keep no-env build invariant (no env var reads at module load). tsc --noEmit must pass. npm run lint must pass. All tests must pass. npm run build must succeed without env vars.
key_patterns: 1. API routes use authorizeStaffRequest(request) from web/lib/auth/staff.ts for staff-only endpoints. 2. DB queries use query() from web/lib/db.ts (lazy, runtime only). 3. Client components are 'use client', data imported from pure TS data files is fine. 4. exportCsv() helper exists in ReportsClient.tsx. 5. METHODS registry in web/lib/methods/registry.ts has all 5 methods with .scale.options. 6. All user-facing strings in Spanish. 7. Method question banks: RIASEC in QUESTIONS (web/data/seed.ts via RIASEC_METHOD.questions), CHASIDE_QUESTIONS, TIPOV_QUESTIONS, CIPR_QUESTIONS, MAGDALENA_QUESTIONS. 8. ResponseScale.options = Array<{value: number, label: string}>.
directory_structure: web/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. web/lib/ - server-side logic (sessions, auth, methods, db). web/components/ - client components (ReportsClient.tsx ~1548 lines, AdminClient.tsx). web/data/ - seed data. web/tests/ - Vitest tests.
